book: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
title: Father Christmas’s Gifts
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. In Chapter 10, Father Christmas brings gifts, and the Witch’s winter starts to break. Build the gifts, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is the snowy wood where Father Christmas stops his sledge, from Chapter 10. He says the gifts are “tools not toys.”

models.name: Medieval Shield
models.why: Peter’s gift, with a red lion

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **sword** and **shield** together for Peter. Put the **bow** for Susan. Put the **bottle** for Lucy. Put the **sewing machine** for Mrs. Beaver.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “The gift I would want is ___ because ___.”
steps.text: Point to one gift and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to one gift and say this out loud. The gift I would want is… because…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the sword, the shield, the bow, the bottle and the sewing machine

extra.text: Add an **Animated Deer** to pull Father Christmas’s sledge. Say what he called out as he left.

points: Your photo shows the sword, the shield, the bow, the bottle and the sewing machine.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read about each gift and tap who got it. Then finish two sentences about the gifts.
mapday.miss: Not that one. Think about who got each gift in Chapter 10.
mapday.done: ✓ Every gift found its owner. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: A snowy wood with a spot for each person who gets a gift

“…a bow and a quiver full of arrows…”
“…a little bottle of what looked like glass…”
